title: Hephaestus learning bundle, format version 1
description: A portable download of one person's learning. It carries only the person's own words, text that the person confirmed word for word, and closed fields. It names no workspace, no piece of work and no other person. A later format version gets its own file, so this file does not change after its first release. A reader also refuses a bundle that this schema cannot check: a file larger than 33554432 bytes (refused before it is parsed), an object with a duplicate key, a portableId that occurs more than once across records, growthPoints and tombstones, a goalId that is not the portableId of a GOAL record in the bundle, a date or time that does not exist (such as February 30), a record whose revisedAt is before its createdAt, an occurredWeek that its year does not have, and text with an unpaired surrogate. A writer puts in records only text about the person's own learning that identifies no other person, directly or indirectly, and in a CONFIRMED record only the exact text that the person confirmed. The stores that feed a bundle hold the limits of this format when they write, so a writer never meets an item past them. A writer leaves out a goalId whose goal the bundle does not carry. A writer may leave out tombstones older than its retention, so a reader treats the tombstones as possibly incomplete. A writer whose bundle would exceed the size limit fails the download with that reason and serves no part of it. A reader treats authorKind, madeBy and origin as claims of the issuing instance, never as proof. Revisions and tombstones compare only within one instanceId and portableId; items with one origin are copies of one item, which a reader may ask the person to choose between. Origin never orders two copies and never changes or removes an item of another issuer without the person's choice.

format.description: Identifies the file as a Hephaestus learning bundle.

formatVersion.description: The format version. A reader refuses a version that it does not know.

bundleId.description: New for each download. With instanceId, it lets an import recognize a bundle that it already read.

instanceId.description: The stable id of the Hephaestus instance that issued the bundle.

generatedAt.description: When the instance generated the bundle.

records.description: The person's records that may leave the instance.

growthPoints.description: The person's growth points for practices with a portable identity.

tombstones.description: Records and growth points that an earlier bundle from this instance could carry and that this bundle does not.

portableId.description: Stable across downloads from one instance. It never changes for the life of the record or the growth point.

revision.description: Grows whenever any value that a bundle carries for the item changes, also its state, its close reason or its restoration after a withdrawal. An item and its tombstones share this counter, so a restoration has a higher revision than the tombstone before it. A change to the goalIds that a bundle carries also raises it. A reader keeps the highest revision of one portableId from one instanceId. On equal revisions, the tombstone wins.

origin.description: Where an imported item first came from. An instance that imported the item copies it unchanged into each later bundle and into the tombstone of the item, so an import recognizes the item again through any number of instances.

practiceKey.description: The portable identity of a practice, in the form <domain>/<slug>. A practice of one workspace has no portable identity and never appears.

record.description: A record in the person's own words, at its confirmed revision.

state.description: A record that waits for the person's review has no confirmed revision and never appears.

closeReason.description: Why the person closed the record. Present exactly when the state is CLOSED.

authorKind.description: WRITTEN: every word of this revision came from the person. CONFIRMED: some words of this revision came from Hephaestus, for example in an accepted suggestion or a kept note, and the person confirmed the whole text as shown. A noted record that the person did not keep never appears.

text.description: Refuses control characters other than tab, line feed and carriage return, and the bidirectional embeddings, overrides and isolates. The bidirectional marks stay, because right-to-left writing needs them.

practiceKeys.description: The portable practices that the record names. Links to a practice of one workspace are left out.

goalIds.description: The goals in this bundle that the person linked the record to. A goal has none.

helpPreference.description: For a goal only: the help that the person chose for this goal. It is the person's own setting; a reader may keep it without applying it.

revisedAt.description: When the person confirmed this revision.

growthPoint.description: One outcome for one piece of work and one practice. It does not identify the piece of work or the workspace.

madeBy.description: Only REVIEW counts in totals. An IMPORT point carries its origin.

occurredWeek.description: The ISO 8601 week of the outcome.

tombstone.description: A record or growth point that an earlier bundle could carry and this one does not. It keeps no content.

reason.description: DELETED: the person deleted it. WITHDRAWN: it still exists but may no longer leave the instance, for example after a recall or a narrower export policy. A reader that applies tombstones removes the item in both cases, and reports only the person's deletion as a deletion. A reader that does not apply them still validates them.

origin.description: Present exactly when the removed item had one.

revision.description: Higher than every revision of the item that a bundle could carry before it was deleted or withdrawn.
